response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages) AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM sex_averages)

assumptions.assumption: A test ratio is undefined when `T-BIL` is zero; `NULLIF` excludes it from the average.
